tenderSchedule.title: Replacement of Existing 66/11kV Power Transformers with 2x20MVA Transformers at Yeldur, Lakshmipura & Kyalanur Sub-Stations, Kolar District
tenderSchedule.description: Combined Package for, Work-A Replacement of existing 1x12.5MVA and 1x8MVA, 66/11kV Power Transformers by 2x20MVA, 66/11kV Power Transformers at 66/11kV Yeldur Sub-station in Kolar Taluk & District. Work-B Replacement of existing 2x12.5MVA, 66/11kV Power Transformers by 2x20MVA, 66/11kV Power Transformers at 66/11kV Lakshmipura Sub-station in Kolar Taluk and District. Work-C Replacement of existing 2x12.5MVA, 66/11kV Power Transformers by 2x20MVA, 66/11kV Power Transformers at 66/11kV Kyalanur Sub-station in Kolar Taluk and District on Total Turnkey Basis, including Supply of all Materials/Equipments and Erection (including dismantling & Civil Works) of all Materials/Equipments, Testing and Commissioning.

POWER TRANSFORMERS: 
a) 20 MVA, 66/11 kV Transformer : 3 Ph, 50 Hz, Core type, 2 winding Delta/Star, Vector Group: DYn11, OLTC, ONAN/ONAF with Fan control cubicle, RTCC Panel, first filling of oil and 10% spare oil in non-returnable drums, etc., complete with Terminal connector suitable for single Drake ACSR on primary side of Transformer and copper flat on 11 kV side and on neutral side as per technical specification. (39.1MT)
Note: Copper Flats required for Power Transformers shall be supplied along with the Transformers as per Technical Specifications.

FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENTS:
Supply,Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Nitrogen Injection fire extinguishing system as per the recommendation of the supplier of the fire fighting system for Power Transformer below 100MVA as per technical specifications.

CURRENT TRANSFORMER :
i) 11kV Class, 25kA, CT of ratio 1200-800/1-1-1A, Outdoor

ii) 11 kV Class, 25kA, NCT of ratio 1200-800/1-1-1A for REFR protection.
NOTE: 1) For details refer APPENDIX-3 : Technical Parameters of current Transformers for type and rating in Section -Instrument Transformer Technical Specfication.
2) All the current transformer in each KV Class shall be of One and the same make for interchangeability and relability of performance.
3) The make & characteristic of 11kV NCT should be the same as that of the Incomer CT of 11kV switchgear.
Total Weight of Station Structure &  Mounting Structures fabricated out of Galvanised Mild Steel (excluding Bolts & nuts) as per Technical Specification
Total Weight of supply of Bolts & nuts of Mounting Structures as per Technical Specification.

BUS BAR FORMATION:
i) Moose ACSR
ii) Drake ACSR
iii) Coyote ACSR

ii) 4 Core 6.0 Sq.mm.

33kV Class, 1Unit/Stack (for 11kV side

d)Heat shrinkable type Cable termination kits suitable for 1Cx 1000 Sq.mm XLPE cable (Out door type)

EARTH MAT FORMATION:
a) Grounding of equipment with 50 x 6 mm G.I. Flat and connecting equipment to the earthmat/ground pit. Each point of earthing with all formation works like bending, twisting, drilling of holes and connecting by welding (inclusive of all T&P and consumables) to the earthmat/ground pit/point of earth connection, all the materials supplied by the contractor.

b) Grounding of equipment by providing cast iron pipe of 100 mm ID 13 mm thickness, 2.75 metre long with 2 part clamp out of G.I. Flat 50 X 6 mm continuously welded alround the pipe using cast iron welding electrodes as per drawing including the cost of excavation (All materials to be supplied by the contractor)
c) Supplying & fixing 450 mm dia 450 mm height 1.5" to 2" thick hume pipe collar (non ressure type) for earth pits including all lead and lifts etc..

1) DECOMMISSIONING 
a) Dismantling of 8 MVA, 66/11 kV, Transformer & parts like bushings with inbuilt 66 kV CTs, releasing of oil from Transformer, etc,.complete as per direction of site Engineer
b) Dismantling of 12.5 MVA, 66/11 kV, Transformer & parts like bushings with inbuilt 66 kV CTs, releasing of oil from Transformer, etc,.complete as per direction of site Engineer
c) Moving of Transformer from the plinth to the loading point as per direction of site Engineer.

2) Releasing and re-erection of Equipments:
a)Releasing and reerection of 11kV NCT mounting structure
b) Releasing and reerection of 11kV Cable mounting Structure
c) Releasing and reerection of HPI mounting Structure/conductor supporting structure
d) Releasing and reerection of existing 11kV NCT

3) Releasing of Equipments:
a) Releasing of existing 11kV NCT/11kV incomer CTs
c) Releasing of existing 11kV Coyote bus
d) Releasing of existing 11kV Drake bus
f) Releasing of existing 11kV NCT mounting structure

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. 
Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  form work, centering & scaffolding  and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.  
M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates -  (3% cosidered for Form work)

Steel Fabrication: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification All other type of structures

Providing and fixing  Structural  Steel  work  in  single  section,  fixed  with  or  without connecting plate, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing 20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:6 (1 cement: 6 fine sand) to brick/stone masonary including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead Cement Concrete Grade M-15 & M-20. By Mechanical Means
Removal of unserviceable soil with disposal upto suitable distance as directed by the Engineer in-charge of work.

Providing and constructing load bearing wall with Solid Concrete blocks of size 400x200x200mm having block density more than 1800kg/m3 and minimum compressive strength of 4.00 N/mm2 conforming to IS 2185 (Part - I) - 2005 and constructed with CM 1:4 as per IS 2572:2005 including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and curing, usage charges of machinery etc complete as per specifications

Supplying PVC ringtite pipes conforming to IS 4985:2000 with latest amendments and conveying to worksite, rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and level and perfect linking at joints, testing and commissioning, including loading unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointing of PVC pipes and specials (excluding cost of specials) with jointing of approved type, with all labour with all lead & lift including encasing the pipe alround to a depth of not less than 15 cms. with soft gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc. complete and giving necessary hydraulic test to the required pressure as per ISS (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) etc. for: PVC pipes 110mm dia., 6 kg/sqcm & class 3
